evidence.observedFact: The active business profile requires at least 24 hours notice for cancellations/rescheduling, may charge 50% for late cancellations, charges 100% for no-shows, and may require a card to secure an appointment.
The business says it has built a loyal clientele and publishes current Willoughby hours plus a business-facing phone number.
The current service menu contains repeatable hair services including root retouch, color, haircuts, blowouts and conditioning/bonding treatments, with online selection available.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate cancellation recovery and rapid rebooking workflows that protect appointment capacity without replacing the salon's existing booking system.
Demonstrate permission-based repeat-visit reminders and reactivation offers around recurring hair-maintenance services.

notes: The business itself states that it has loyal clientele; this is treated as an existing retention asset, not a loyalty deficiency. Reactivation is an opportunity hypothesis based on recurring service categories. No monetary loss is claimed.
